preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 1000
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 1000) representing the number of test cases.
Each test case's first line contains exactly three integers n, x, y (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5, 0 ≤ x ≤ y ≤ n) separated by spaces.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains exactly n integers b_1,...,b_n (1 ≤ b_i ≤ n+1) representing Bob's guess, where n is the length of the code from the first line.
The sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.description: For each test case, the first line of output is either 'YES' or 'NO', indicating whether a valid secret code exists.

postconditions.expression: all('YES' in line or 'NO' in line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: Every non-empty line of output is either 'YES' or 'NO' or a valid secret code (when 'YES' is printed).

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() == 'YES' and line != 'YES')
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed for a test case, the next line contains exactly n integers a_1,...,a_n (1 ≤ a_i ≤ n+1) representing a valid secret code.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a_i) <= n + 1 for a_i in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() == 'YES' and line != 'YES')
postconditions.description: Each integer in the secret code is between 1 and n+1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for i in range(n) if int(a_i) == int(b_i)) == x for (n, x, y), b, a in zip(test_cases, guesses, secret_codes))
postconditions.description: For each test case where 'YES' is printed, the number of indices where the secret code a matches Bob's guess b exactly is x.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(a) & set(b)) == y for (n, x, y), b, a in zip(test_cases, guesses, secret_codes))
postconditions.description: For each test case where 'YES' is printed, the size of the intersection of the secret code a and Bob's guess b as multisets is y. This is equivalent to the sum of the minimum counts of each color in a and b being equal to y.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 0 or line.strip() == 'YES' or line.strip() == 'NO' for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: Output lines are either empty, 'YES', 'NO', or a valid secret code line.
